entries.title: Reported warning: do not eat cold smoked sprats from Haifa Smoked Fish
entries.text: A serious warning was reported about all lots of cold smoked sprats sold by Haifa Smoked Fish of Jamaica, NY. They may be contaminated with C. botulinum, the germ that causes botulism, a dangerous illness. The sprats went to stores, fish counters, restaurants and wholesalers in NJ, NY, CT and PA, and possibly further, and were sometimes sold loose with no label. The fish can keep for a long time in the freezer, so check your freezer too. If you are not sure where your cold smoked sprats came from, do not eat them - throw them out or ask the store, and wash anything they touched. Signs of botulism include nausea, vomiting, blurred or double vision, trouble speaking or swallowing, and weakness; anyone with these signs should get medical care immediately. No other Haifa Smoked Fish products are included in this warning.
